name: Snow Colony

categories.label: Building points (bottom-right of building cards)
categories.hint: Sum the VP printed on every building in your town (end-game scoring).

categories.label: Points gained during play
categories.hint: VP collected by landing on spaces during play.

categories.label: Bonus goal cards
categories.hint: Sum VP of goal cards fulfilled (starting goal and any bought with fish).

categories.label: Tourist (visitor) cards fulfilled
categories.hint: Sum VP of fulfilled tourist cards; unfulfilled ones score nothing.

categories.label: Igloos placed
categories.hint: Points depend on the number of igloos placed; enter the VP from the igloo scoring track.

endCondition.description: Game ends when a player places their 8th igloo; the current round is completed so everyone has equal turns.

notes: family: end-game-categories. Igloo VP values, tiebreaker, and exact tourist/goal values are printed on components or in the rulebook and were not verified; modelled as scorer inputs. Based on BGG rules threads and a review (publisher's rulebook not downloadable). Igloos are earned by completing a loop of your town or accumulating 5 staff penguins on a building.
